svg.text: ▸ 3rd-year B.Tech CSE undergrad at GGSIPU specializing in Machine Learning engineering,
high-throughput backend architecture, and AI safety framework design.
▸ Building resilient, production AI systems — from voice-first LLM copilots (GallaSaathi)
